notes: The owner: "remove the IRC Accounts and only offer XMPP… there shouldn't be any need to leave any vestiges of IRC support — it has not been used or configured for any purpose and hasn't even been tested." Because nothing was ever configured or received over IRC, the removal is total rather than a retirement-with-compatibility: the IRC protocol core and its suite are deleted; the IRC accounts panel, form option and default ports are gone; the trust boundary's irc identity/conversation rules and the services_account basis are removed (the ONE identity basis is bare_jid); every door refuses non-X
